# `schedule.plan`

Print supported local-jobs commands to retain local curation on demand and retire its independent timer. The connected host owns the daily cycle. This operation is read-only.

- **group:** `read`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice schedule-plan`
- **MCP tool:** `schedule_plan`

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `interval_seconds` | `int` | optional, default=86400 | Deprecated compatibility input; no passive timer is created. |
| `per_source_limit` | `int` | optional, default=None | Optional bounded per-source candidate cap for large catch-up backlogs. |

## Examples

```
operator-voice schedule-plan
```

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
